from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from decimal import Decimal
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
import json,csv,hashlib,re
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/"reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1"
REL=OUT.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
assert not (OUT/"result.json").exists()
assert not (OUT/"model_protocol.json").exists()
def read(name): return json.loads((OUT/name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def save(name,value):
    p=OUT/name
    assert not p.exists(),"不覆盖已保存结果："+name
    p.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

parents=read("source_parent_hashes.json")
for x in parents: assert digest(ROOT/x["path"])==x["sha256"],"冻结父输入变化："+x["path"]
pdfs=read("pdf_receipts.json")
summary=read("全部16原报告全文与封面核对.json")
meta={x["quarter"]:x["metadata"] for x in summary}
contracts=read("16季度企业贷款字段原文合同.json")
with (OUT/"16季度企业贷款表3原值.csv").open(encoding="utf-8-sig",newline="") as handle: rows=list(csv.DictReader(handle))
assert [r["季度"] for r in rows]==proto["fixed_quarters"]
assert len(pdfs)==len(rows)==len(contracts)==16
assert all(x["cover_exact_requested_quarter"] for x in summary)
raws=read("release_probe_receipts.json")+read("first_catalog_receipts.json")+read("remaining_release_receipts.json")+pdfs

for x in raws:
    assert x["successfully_received"]
    assert digest(ROOT/x["path"])==x["sha256"],"原对象发生变化："+x["path"]
version_rows=[]
for source,row,contract in zip(pdfs,rows,contracts):
    assert source["quarter"]==row["季度"]==contract["季度"]
    assert row["单位"]=="%" and row["企业贷款利率_百分数"]==contract["企业贷款利率_百分数"]
    published=date.fromisoformat(row["页面显示公布时间"][:10])
    filename=Path(urlsplit(source["url"]).path).name
    file_hint=re.match(r"(\d{8})",filename)
    assert file_hint
    file_day=date.fromisoformat(file_hint.group(1)[:4]+"-"+file_hint.group(1)[4:6]+"-"+file_hint.group(1)[6:8])
    metadata=meta[source["quarter"]]
    metadata_days={}
    for k in ["CreationDate","ModDate"]:
        m=re.match(r"D:(\d{8})",metadata.get(k,""))
        if m:
            v=m.group(1);metadata_days[k]=date.fromisoformat(v[:4]+"-"+v[4:6]+"-"+v[6:8])
    late=file_day>published
    metadata_late=any(v>published for v in metadata_days.values())
    version_rows.append({
        "季度":row["季度"],"统计月":row["统计月"],"企业贷款利率_百分数":row["企业贷款利率_百分数"],
        "原发布页显示时间":row["页面显示公布时间"],"PDF文件名":filename,
        "文件名日期线索":file_day.isoformat(),"文件名晚于原发布日_天":(file_day-published).days,
        "原PDF元数据":metadata,"元数据晚日期线索":metadata_late,
        "当前PDF与原发布日的目标值映射已建立":False if late or metadata_late else "NOT_CERTIFIED_FIRST_VINTAGE",
        "时钟判断":"LATER_FILE_AND_METADATA_NO_OLD_TARGET_BINDING" if late and metadata_late else "CURRENT_VERSION_FIRST_VINTAGE_NOT_CERTIFIED",
        "PDF路径":source["path"],"PDF_SHA256":source["sha256"],
        "边界":"文件名和元数据只作版本线索，不作为正式公开时刻；生成较晚不证明数值必改，也不证明原日已有同值。"
    })
late=[x for x in version_rows if x["文件名晚于原发布日_天"]>0 and x["元数据晚日期线索"]]

    writer.writerows([{k:v for k,v in x.items() if k in fields} for x in version_rows])
